newsitem.title: UK: WH Smith loyalty card to start Wednesday.
newsitem.headline: WH Smith loyalty card to start Wednesday.

text.p: British retailer WH Smith said on Monday a loyalty card offering a two percent discount to customers would be available in its shops from Wednesday.
The company said in a statement the discount offered to its 'Clubcard' holders in its 400 stores was double that offered by supermarket loyalty schemes.
"We have carried out an extensive trial of Clubcard in 53 stores in the Midlands and the North East of England," said Liz Harlow, who manages the scheme.
"The card significantly increased sales and we are confident that the success of this regional trial will be repeated at a national level."
